def parse_records(text):
    lines=text.splitlines()
    out=[]
    for l in lines:
        # Only skip whole-line comments: first non-blank character is '#'
        if l.strip() and l.strip()[0]=='#': continue
        out.append(l)  # preserve surrounding whitespace verbatim
    return [x for x in out if x]  # blank lines stay excluded (intended)
